$comment: Model artifacts the extension ships. `artifacts` are downloaded once by `npm run fetch:models`, pinned to an immutable commit and verified by SHA-256 — that is the only step in this project that touches the network. `bundled` artifacts are checked into the repository because no upstream publishes them in this format; scripts/convert-siglip.py regenerates them deterministically (verified: the same SHA-256 on a clean re-run).

artifacts.attribution: Jeongsoo Park and Andrew Owens, University of Michigan, CVPR 2025 (arXiv:2411.04125). ONNX export by Han Yoon / Borderless.

bundled.attribution: Ateeqq/ai-vs-human-image-detector, Apache-2.0. Exported to ONNX and dynamically quantized by scripts/convert-siglip.py; upstream publishes safetensors only.
